capabilities: show control and non-printing characters in edit mode
restrict character display to selected text
override display settings per note via properties
customize styling through the Style Settings plugin
extras: The README credits @nothingislost for reference plugins.
problem: Obsidian hides control characters like newlines, so invisible formatting characters are hard to spot while editing.

relations.evidence: You can customize most of the styling with the Style Settings plugin.

summary: Editing aid that displays control and non-printing characters in edit mode, with selection-only mode and per-note property overrides.
